tagline: Play the water with sound and ripples
intro: The first note begins at your fingertips.
description: Draw a line to make a string. Pull and release it to send sound and ripples across the water.
canvas: A water surface played with strings and ripples
instructions: Drag across open water to draw a string, then pull it sideways and release. Longer strings sound lower and shorter ones higher. The length sets the pitch without automatic tuning. The frequency and nearest note appear beside your hand.
drawPitch: Pitch of the string being drawn: {pitch}
calmHint: A, C and E sound calm together.
clearHint: C, E and G make a bright chord.
warmHint: F, A and C make a warm chord.
harmonyHelp: The faint marker suggests a length. Changing the chord leaves existing strings at their original pitches. Add three starter strings to use the chosen chord. The phrase plays your strings for about five seconds. Touch the water or press Esc to stop.
playHelp: Pause stops motion and sound. With reduced motion enabled, press Play to start. You can also play with the buttons below.
empty: No strings yet. Choose Create string to begin.
drawFeedback: The length you draw sets the pitch, with no automatic tuning.
moreStrings: Try different lengths. Longer strings sound lower.
playOwn: Pull and release the strings in your own order.
demoFeedback: Playing your strings. Touch the water to stop.
drawnPitch: {pitch}. The pitch follows the length you draw.
slowNotice: This is taking a little longer. Loading time depends on your connection.
ready: The water is ready. You can play now.
loadError: Couldn’t load the water. Check your connection and reload.
reduced: Reduced motion is on. Press Play to set the strings and water in motion.
paused: Motion paused. Press Play to start the strings and ripples.
reducedPause: Paused for reduced motion. Press Play to resume.
silent: Audio is unavailable in this browser environment. You can still play visually.
pressPlay: Press Play to create and play strings.
keyboard: Use Tab to move and Enter or Space to press a button. A bright dot marks the selected string.
enableJS: To play Janhyang, enable JavaScript in your browser and reopen this page.
languageError: Couldn’t load that language. Check your connection and select it again.
